content_data.project_title: Interactive Learning Journey Design for European Education Innovation
content_data.project_description: A comprehensive proposal for developing engaging and visually compelling user experiences for educational research platforms, focusing on accessibility and pedagogical effectiveness across European contexts.
content_data.timeline: Over the next 6 months, comprising a discovery phase (month 1), design and prototyping (months 2-4), and refinement with user testing (months 5-6).
objectives: To ensure design solutions are culturally sensitive and adaptable for diverse European user groups.
To provide design guidelines and assets for future platform scalability and content integration.
To create an intuitive and aesthetically pleasing user interface for a new educational research portal.
deliverables: Front-end Design Specifications for development handover
Comprehensive UI/UX Design System (including style guide, components, iconography)
Accessibility Design Report (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance focus)
technical_specs: Interaction flows documented with state changes for developers.
Typography specified with web-safe fonts and fallback options.
Adherence to atomic design methodology for component-based development.
Design files provided in Figma, with assets optimized for web (SVG, PNG, WebP).
Color palettes defined using HEX, RGB, and HSL values for consistent brand application.
inspiration_references: Google Material Design guidelines (for structured UI and accessibility)
Behance and Dribbble portfolios showcasing innovative EdTech UI/UX.
Duolingo's gamified learning experience (for engagement patterns)
Selected European educational platforms for best practices in academic content presentation.
The Noun Project (for clear, universal iconography)
